name: material_define
description: Create a material, or fully replace an existing one with the same id (upsert, FULL REPLACE: omitted optional fields are cleared and roughness resets to 0.9, so send every field you want to keep). A material kind ("paint" or "texture") can never change; use a new id for a different kind. For a library texture use kind "texture" with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (slugs: library[].slug from list_materials). Define a material before using it in a finish.

id.description: Material id (1-64 characters), unique across all entities. Reference it from finishes and defaults.

kind.description: "paint" is a flat colour; "texture" adds a PBR texture set (needs textureUrl). Cannot change once defined.

color.description: Base colour as #rrggbb. For textures it is the fallback and tint colour.

roughness.description: Surface roughness from 0 (mirror) to 1 (matte). Defaults to 0.9.

textureUrl.description: Texture set as "lib:<slug>"; read materials://list for the available slugs. Required when kind is "texture".

textureScale.description: Size in metres of one texture tile. Optional.

material.description: The complete material. An existing id is fully replaced (omitted optional fields are cleared); kind cannot change.

name: material_remove
description: Delete a material. Fails with precondition_failed (naming the users) while a wall, a room (floor, ceiling or wall finish) or a default still uses it; reassign those first.

id.description: Id of the material to delete (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials). Fails with precondition_failed while any wall, room or default uses it.

name: wall_set_finish
description: Paint one or both faces of a wall (wall ids: walls[].wallId from describe_room, which also says which side faces the room). Pass roomId (strongly recommended) to paint only that room's stretch of the face: the alcove and the sejour can share a wall and get different colours. Without roomId the whole face is painted for every room on it. Precedence on a stretch of face, most specific first: the room-scoped finish (roomId), the whole-face finish, the room's paint-all-walls (room_set_wall_finish), the scene default. Left and right follow the walking direction from wall start to end on the plan (plan y grows down). materialId null clears the finish.

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].wallId from describe_room).

side.description: Which face of the wall. "left" is the left of someone walking from the wall start to its end on the plan (plan y grows down; describe_room gives the side that faces each room), "right" the other face, "both" both faces. With roomId, "both" means every face of this wall that the room adjoins.

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials, or materials[].id from get_scene_summary with detail "full"), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material_define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (library[].slug from list_materials).

roomId.description: The room whose stretch of this wall side to paint (rooms[].id from list_rooms). Strongly recommended: a wall side can be shared by several rooms (e.g. the alcove and the sejour) and without roomId the whole side is painted for all of them. Fails with precondition_failed if the room does not border that side. A room-scoped finish beats the whole-side finish and room_set_wall_finish.

name: wall_set_structural
description: Mark a wall structural (never removable) or removable, or clear the mark. Walls that are exterior or at least 15 cm thick are structural by default; only a user may mark such a wall removable (an LLM gets precondition_failed).

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].wallId from describe_room).

structural.description: true marks the wall structural (cannot be removed); false marks it removable; null clears the explicit mark so it is derived (exterior or at least 15 cm thick means structural). Only a user may set false on a wall that is structural by default.

name: room_set_wall_finish
description: Paint all the walls of a room with one material (the room's own stretches only: neighbouring rooms keep their look, even on shared wall faces). It replaces any earlier per-wall paint of that room; a later wall_set_finish on one of its walls wins again. materialId null removes the room paint. Fails with no_wall_sides when none of the room's edges run along a wall face (an unwalled room).

roomId.description: Id of the room (rooms[].id from list_rooms).

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials, or materials[].id from get_scene_summary with detail "full"), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material_define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (library[].slug from list_materials).

name: room_set_floor
description: Set the floor material of a room (null clears it so the scene default applies).

roomId.description: Id of the room (rooms[].id from list_rooms).

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials, or materials[].id from get_scene_summary with detail "full"), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material_define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (library[].slug from list_materials).

name: room_set_ceiling
description: Set the ceiling material of a room (null clears it so the scene default applies).

roomId.description: Id of the room (rooms[].id from list_rooms).

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials, or materials[].id from get_scene_summary with detail "full"), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material_define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (library[].slug from list_materials).

ceiling.description: Default ceiling material. Omit to leave unchanged, null to clear.

description: Change site fields (location, orientation, time zone, floor elevation, address). Omitted fields stay unchanged; address null clears it.

floorElevation.description: Height of the flat floor above street level, in metres.

address.description: Postal address (at most 300 characters); null clears it.

site.description: Fields to change; omitted fields stay as they are.

name: item_place
description: Put a real, purchasable product into a room. Only products returned by search_products may be placed; an item without productRef or product is refused with precondition_failed ("search_products first"). Normally use place_item, which finds a valid position and rotation and fills in the product facts (price, dims, link) from the server's record; never type those yourself. The item is refused with placement_invalid when it would stand outside its room, overlap a wall or another item, or block a door swing (the message and hint say which and what to try). Windows, glazing, heavy wall mounts and walkways are checked by place_item and validate_layout. Item frame: the front faces plan +y at rotation 0; rotation is degrees counter-clockwise seen from above; a floor item has elevation 0. The id is derived (item-N) when omitted. At most 60 items per room. Undo removes the item.

id.description: Optional item id (1-64 characters, unique across all entities); derived as "item-N" when omitted.

assetId.description: Shape id: "product:<provider>", a library asset id or "param:<generator>" (see meshAssetId); legacy "builtin:*" ids still load.

position.description: Plan position [x, y] of the item origin (footprint centre), in metres; plan y grows down.

elevation.description: Height of the item bottom above the floor, in metres; must be 0 for floor items. Defaults to 0.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above; the front faces plan +y at 0. Defaults to 0.

roomId.description: Room the item stands in (rooms[].id from list_rooms); derived from the position when omitted. Optional.

productRef.description: The real product this item stands for. Required for items placed by an LLM or the planner (unless product is given).

name.description: Product name as listed by the provider.

price.description: Shelf price including VAT (TTC) in `currency`, as returned by the server.

d.description: Depth in metres (item-local z; the front is at +d/2).

h.description: Height in metres (item-local y, measured up from the item bottom).

dims.description: Assembled outer dimensions in metres, as returned by the server.

snapshotAt.description: When the facts were read from the provider (ISO 8601 date-time).

colour.description: Chosen colour when the product has several. Optional.

product.description: Product facts (name, TTC price, link, dims, snapshot date) as returned by the server; never invented.

mount.description: Where the item is fixed: "floor", "wall" (hung) or "ceiling". Optional; derived from the asset.

d.description: Depth in metres (item-local z; the front is at +d/2).

h.description: Height in metres (item-local y, measured up from the item bottom).

dims.description: Exact outer dimensions in metres; defaults to the product dimensions. Optional.

variant.description: Chosen variant SKU or colour name of the product. Optional.

kind.description: Mesh source discriminator, always "provider": the provider's real model of productRef, streamed by the local server.
Mesh source discriminator, always "lookalike": a library model scaled to the exact dims.
Mesh source discriminator, always "parametric": a generator at the exact dims.

params.description: Scalar generator parameters; omitted keys use the generator defaults.

mesh.description: How the 3D shape is obtained (provider model, library lookalike or parametric generator). Optional.

front.description: Free space wanted in front, in metres. Optional.

back.description: Free space wanted behind, in metres. Optional.

left.description: Free space wanted on the left seen from the front, in metres. Optional.

right.description: Free space wanted on the right seen from the front, in metres. Optional.

clearance.description: Free space wanted around the item, in metres per side. Optional.

locked.description: Existing furniture the designer must plan around (only the user may set it). Optional.

wallId.description: Wall to stand against (walls[].wallId from describe_room).

roomId.description: Room on the wall side to use when a wall borders two rooms (rooms[].id).

align.description: Where along the wall, seen from the room: its start end, its middle, or its end.

offset.description: Metres from the aligned end of the wall to the nearest edge of the item (ignored for "center").

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

roomId.description: Room whose corner to use (rooms[].id).

corner.description: Index of the room polygon vertex (rooms[].polygon order); 0 is the first vertex.

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

roomId.description: Room to centre in (rooms[].id).

axis.description: Centre on both plan axes, or only on x / y (the other coordinate is then kept).

targetId.description: Entity to face: an item id, an opening id, a wall id or a room id.

itemId.description: The existing item to stand next to (items[].id).

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

align.description: Alignment along that side: start, middle or end.

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

item.description: The complete item: position, rotation, productRef + product snapshot, dims, mesh source and relation, as resolved by the placement solver.

name: item_move
description: Move a placed item (items[].id from describe_room) to a new plan position, optionally with a new rotation, height, room or placement relation. Omitted fields stay as they are; roomId and relation accept null to clear. Refused with placement_invalid when the new spot is outside the room, over a wall or another item, or in a door swing, and with precondition_failed for a locked item (existing furniture such as a built-in wardrobe; only the user may move it). Call validate_layout afterwards to check windows and walkways. Undo moves it back.

name: item_rotate
description: Turn a placed item to an absolute rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above (the front faces plan +y at 0, +x at 90, -y at 180, -x at 270). The footprint turns about the item origin and is checked like item_move (placement_invalid when it no longer fits). Locked items cannot be rotated by an LLM. Undo restores the previous rotation.

id.description: Id of the item (items[].id from describe_room or get_scene_summary).

name: item_set_variant
description: Switch a placed product to another variant (variants[].sku of the product record): a colour or size, usually another article with its own price and dimensions. Pass the variant SKU and the product snapshot and dims the server resolved for it; variant null clears the choice, dims null returns to the product dimensions. The new dimensions are checked like item_move (placement_invalid when the item no longer fits). Undo restores the previous variant, price and dimensions.

description: Remove a placed item by id (items[].id from describe_room). A locked item (existing furniture) can only be removed by the user. Undo puts it back at the same position in the list.

h.description: Height in metres (item-local y, measured up from the item bottom).

dims.description: Exact outer dimensions in metres; defaults to the product dimensions. Optional.

variant.description: Chosen variant SKU or colour name of the product. Optional.

kind.description: Mesh source discriminator, always "provider": the provider's real model of productRef, streamed by the local server.
Mesh source discriminator, always "lookalike": a library model scaled to the exact dims.
Mesh source discriminator, always "parametric": a generator at the exact dims.

params.description: Scalar generator parameters; omitted keys use the generator defaults.

mesh.description: How the 3D shape is obtained (provider model, library lookalike or parametric generator). Optional.

front.description: Free space wanted in front, in metres. Optional.

back.description: Free space wanted behind, in metres. Optional.

left.description: Free space wanted on the left seen from the front, in metres. Optional.

right.description: Free space wanted on the right seen from the front, in metres. Optional.

clearance.description: Free space wanted around the item, in metres per side. Optional.

locked.description: Existing furniture the designer must plan around (only the user may set it). Optional.

wallId.description: Wall to stand against (walls[].wallId from describe_room).

roomId.description: Room on the wall side to use when a wall borders two rooms (rooms[].id).

align.description: Where along the wall, seen from the room: its start end, its middle, or its end.

offset.description: Metres from the aligned end of the wall to the nearest edge of the item (ignored for "center").

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

roomId.description: Room whose corner to use (rooms[].id).

corner.description: Index of the room polygon vertex (rooms[].polygon order); 0 is the first vertex.

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

roomId.description: Room to centre in (rooms[].id).

axis.description: Centre on both plan axes, or only on x / y (the other coordinate is then kept).

targetId.description: Entity to face: an item id, an opening id, a wall id or a room id.

itemId.description: The existing item to stand next to (items[].id).

side.description: Side of that item, as seen from its front.

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

align.description: Alignment along that side: start, middle or end.

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

position.description: Plan position [x, y] of the item origin (footprint centre).

elevation.description: Height of the item bottom above the floor, in metres.

relation.description: The placement intent that put the item here (as returned by place_item). Optional.

item.description: The complete item: position, rotation, productRef + product snapshot, dims, mesh source and relation, as resolved by the placement solver.

id.description: Id of the item (items[].id from describe_room or get_scene_summary).

position.description: New plan position [x, y] of the item origin, in metres.

elevation.description: New height of the item bottom above the floor, in metres. Optional.

rotation.description: New rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above. Optional.

roomId.description: Room the item now belongs to (rooms[].id); null clears it. Optional.

offset.description: Metres from the aligned end of the wall to the nearest edge of the item (ignored for "center").

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

corner.description: Index of the room polygon vertex (rooms[].polygon order); 0 is the first vertex.

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

roomId.description: Room to centre in (rooms[].id).

axis.description: Centre on both plan axes, or only on x / y (the other coordinate is then kept).

targetId.description: Entity to face: an item id, an opening id, a wall id or a room id.

itemId.description: The existing item to stand next to (items[].id).

side.description: Side of that item, as seen from its front.

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

align.description: Alignment along that side: start, middle or end.

gap.description: Free gap in metres between the item and what it touches (default 0).

position.description: Plan position [x, y] of the item origin (footprint centre).

elevation.description: Height of the item bottom above the floor, in metres.

relation.description: The placement intent that produced this position; null clears it. Optional.

id.description: Id of the item (items[].id from describe_room or get_scene_summary).

rotation.description: Absolute rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above (the front faces plan +y at 0).

id.description: Id of the item (items[].id from describe_room or get_scene_summary).

variant.description: Variant SKU of the product (variants[].sku); null clears it.

name.description: Product name as listed by the provider.

price.description: Shelf price including VAT (TTC) in `currency`, as returned by the server.

d.description: Depth in metres (item-local z; the front is at +d/2).

h.description: Height in metres (item-local y, measured up from the item bottom).

dims.description: Assembled outer dimensions in metres, as returned by the server.

snapshotAt.description: When the facts were read from the provider (ISO 8601 date-time).

colour.description: Chosen colour when the product has several. Optional.

product.description: Snapshot of the chosen variant (resolved by the server from its record; never invented). Optional.

d.description: Depth in metres (item-local z; the front is at +d/2).

h.description: Height in metres (item-local y, measured up from the item bottom).

dims.description: Dimensions of the chosen variant when they differ; null clears them back to the product dimensions. Optional.
